answer.answer: Neither. ST-EVA holds no current price-to-sales figure for AAPL, and it holds no price-to-sales figure for any period, so there is nothing to classify as SOURCE_REPORTED or DERIVED and no stored expression or operand set to report. A P/S ratio is not a metric ST-EVA knows: requesting it was refused by name, and the metric list returned in the refusal contains no valuation multiple of any kind, and no market capitalisation or share-price metric either. For AAPL specifically, the coverage report enumerates the twelve metrics held, and none is a valuation ratio. The denominator input alone is present — revenue is held as SOURCE_REPORTED from SEC filings, with the most recent observations being 109,417,000,000 USD for the quarter ended 2026-06-27 and 364,357,000,000 USD for the nine months then ended — but the numerator input is not held, so a P/S could not be assembled from what is there in any case. I am not supplying a P/S figure, because no tool returned one.
uncertainties: The question presupposes a current P/S for AAPL exists in ST-EVA. Nothing held supports that premise, so the question cannot be answered as posed.

No P/S observation, derived value, or lineage chain exists to inspect; the absence is at the metric-registry level, established by the refusal of the metric name and the coverage report, not by an empty filtered result.
ST-EVA holds only filed financial data for AAPL, with no market price or market capitalisation, so even a computed P/S was not available from these tools at any point in the series.
I cannot rule out that a P/S was reported or computed somewhere outside ST-EVA; that would not be evidence I can cite.
